findings.issue: The keyed answer D (Sunday-evening reminders) is supported as helping more than the extra voucher, but the stem asks broadly what helped retention “most.” The same script also says shortening the survey made half-finished surveys fall sharply, so a learner could reasonably choose the questionnaire reduction as the more effective intervention.
findings.suggestion: Narrow the stem to the explicit comparison, e.g. “Which incentive did Tom say helped more than the extra money?”

findings.issue: The passage is 492 words, short for a standalone IELTS Academic Reading Passage 1. Its five questions are answerable, but the passage gives much less sustained reading practice than a full passage-level task.
findings.suggestion: Expand the passage to a more representative length (roughly 700–900 words) or label it clearly as a short excerpt/practice set.
